verdict.rationale: This story asks whether authorized third parties (law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers) can access scoped slices of a company's equity data, which is a capability of an equity or cap-table system of record. Claude is a general AI assistant and model platform, so the axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude storing or exposing equity data, and connector, SSO and API key features are unrelated.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
